title: High-dimensional limit theorems for adaptive variants of SGD I: Ballistic limits
abstract: arXiv:2611.19059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop the high-dimensional effective dynamics for adaptive, momentum-based variants of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). These effective dynamics are given by a Markov process. They key observation is that the non-Markovianity in the algorithm due to the exponential moving average and preconditioning can be treated using the method of averaging. Our approach applies to a broad class of algorithms including to Adaptive momentum estimation (ADAM), Momentum orthogonalized by Newton-Schultz (MUON), and its variants. It also applies to a broad class of learning tasks, such at tensor PCA, Gaussian projective models, teacher-student networks, and a multi-layer neural network trained on the XOR problem using a hybrid of MUON and ADAM as commonly done in practice. We demonstrate how to this technique can give precise, quantitative comparisons between algorithms. In particular, we find interesting phenomena, such as the cross-over phenomen

translated_title: 随机梯度下降（SGD）自适应变体的高维极限定理 I：弹道极限
translated_abstract: 我们为基于动量的自适应随机梯度下降（SGD）变体建立了高维有效动力学。这些有效动力学由一个马尔可夫过程给出。关键观察是，算法中由指数移动平均和预条件化所导致的非马尔可夫性可以通过平均化方法来处理。我们的方法适用于一大类算法，包括自适应动量估计（ADAM）、基于牛顿-舒尔茨正交化的动量方法（MUON）及其变体。该方法还适用于广泛的学习任务，例如张量PCA、高斯投影模型、师生网络，以及使用实践中常见的MUON与ADAM混合方法在XOR问题上训练的多层神经网络。我们展示了该技术如何在算法之间进行精确的定量比较。特别地，我们发现了有趣的现象，例如交叉（cross-over）现象。
tldr: 本文通过平均化方法将ADAM、MUON等自适应动量SGD变体中由指数移动平均和预条件化引起的非马尔可夫性转化为马尔可夫有效动力学，建立了高维极限定理，从而实现对不同优化算法的精确定量比较。
en_tdlr: This paper develops high-dimensional limit theorems for adaptive momentum-based SGD variants such as ADAM and MUON, using the averaging method to convert their non-Markovian dynamics into Markovian effective dynamics, enabling precise quantitative comparisons between optimization algorithms.
